caption: The drawing depicts a small, rectangular wooden box with a single open drawer that is divided into two compartments. The box stands on a flat surface and features a decorative backboard that curves upward into a semi-circular shape with two symmetrical cutouts on either side and a small diamond-shaped hole in the center. The surface of the wood is shaded to suggest a brown or natural wood color, and the front of the drawer, as well as the front panel of the box, are decorated with engraved or painted circles. The entire object appears to be crafted from wood with visible grain, and there is a round knob centered on the front of the drawer. The drawing itself is bordered by a rectangular frame and set against a light, off-white background.
title: Spice Box
